title: Undead Alliance
description: Turn zombies into loyal companions with trust, personality, and smart AI. Recruit, command, and survive together in Minecraft.
body:
# 🧟 Undead Alliance

A Minecraft Mod that lets you turn zombies into loyal companions instead of enemies.

Survive the apocalypse with your own undead allies, each featuring **personality, trust, and evolving behavior systems**.

---

## ⚙️ FEATURES

### 🤝 Zombie Recruitment
Sneak + right-click on a zombie to attempt recruitment with a base success chance of **40%**, modified by personality traits.

---

### 🧠 Trust System
Each zombie has a dynamic trust level (0–100):

- **0–19 → Hostile** (breaks alliance)
- **20–49 → Suspicious** (may retaliate)
- **50–79 → Friendly** (follows & protects)
- **80–100 → Loyal** (best behavior)

---

### 🎭 Personalities
Each zombie has unique behavior traits:

- **Loyal** – easier recruitment, more forgiving  
- **Brave** – aggressive combat style  
- **Coward** – prioritizes survival  
- **Protective** – stays close to owner  
- **Lazy** – slower movement  
- **Grumpy** – harder to recruit  

---

### 🪖 Helmet Protection
Helmets prevent zombies from burning in sunlight and slightly increase trust.

---

### 🍖 Feeding System
Feed rotten flesh to heal zombies and increase trust (only when needed).

---

### 🏕️ Smart AI
Allied zombies will:

- Seek shade or water when burning  
- Follow or stay based on commands  
- Protect the owner from attackers  
- Request food when low on health  

---

### 💾 Persistence
All alliance data (trust, personality, ownership, states) is saved using **NBT storage**.

---

## 💬 COMMANDS (/ua)

- `/ua trust` – View trust level  
- `/ua info` – Full zombie information  
- `/ua personality` – Show personality details  
- `/ua recruitdebug` – Force recruit nearby zombie  
- `/ua follow` – Make zombie follow you  
- `/ua stay` – Make zombie stay in place  
- `/ua debug` – Developer debug info  
- `/ua reload` – Placeholder command  

---

## ⚠️ DEVELOPMENT STATUS

This mod is currently **UNDER DEVELOPMENT**.

You may encounter bugs, unfinished behaviors, or balancing issues. Updates will continue to improve stability, AI behavior, and overall gameplay experience.

### 🔮 Planned Updates
- Improved zombie AI pathfinding  
- More personality types  
- Better combat balancing  
- Bug fixes and performance improvements  
- Expanded interaction system  

---

## 🧩 COMPATIBILITY
- Minecraft **1.21.1**
- Fabric Loader
- Recommended on both client & server
